notes.title: Grateful free update (1.0.4)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948935/1b4dfbe56ecf17d692688110248c02d8781dc991.png[/img]
To commemorate the visit of many gentlemen and ladies, "Free Appreciation Update (Patch 1.0.4)" was released today.
This update adds "Cheki Pose" and "Present Pants".
Five types of Cheki Pose and five types of Pants will be added for each cast member as gifts.
Both will appear as the game progresses.

notes.title: "Bunny Garden" at Gamers Store!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948935/144a2e14d9498189f9f431cc477efb800889d64d.jpg[/img]
We have prepared not only standard goods such as can badges and key chains, but also mug cups, desk mats, and other goods that are easy to use in everyday life!			
The SD character illustrations are newly drawn for the traveling store!			
Please be sure to purchase these valuable goods, which are only available here.			
			
■Store Information			
Bunny Garden Gamers Store			
https://www.gamers.co.jp/contents/event_fair/detail.php?id=4809			
Period: May 17 (Fri.) - June 2 (Sun.), 2024			
Location: AKIHABARA Gamers main store, Gamers mail order			
Description: For every 3,000 yen (including tax) spent on "Bunny Garden" related goods during the period, a special "business card-style card (total 6 kinds)" will be given away.			
Special offer: Business card-style card (total of 6 kinds)			
You can not choose your favorite card.			
*Orders may be closed when the maximum number of cards is reached, even during the order acceptance period.			
Ordering period is subject to change without notice. Please understand that the order period is subject to change without notice.			
			
List of products for sale			
Can badge collection (total 6 kinds)			
Acrylic Key Chain Collection (total 6 kinds)			
2L size bromide collection (total 6 kinds)			
Mug Cup Collection (Total 3 kinds)			
Acrylic Multi Stand (Total 3 Kinds)			
Acrylic Character Stand (Total 3 Kinds)			
Multi desk mat (5 kinds)			
B2 tapestry (W suede)(5 kinds)			
Chara Fine Graph (1 kind)			
			
Related URL			
Bunny Garden Gamers sub-branch feature page / Mail order related products page			
https://www.gamers.co.jp/contents/event_fair/detail.php?id=4809			
Orders will be accepted until 23:59, June 2, 2024 (Sun.).			
			
The images are for illustrative purposes only. Actual products may differ.			
The release and specifications of the products may be subject to change, postponement, or cancellation due to various reasons. Please understand.
